videos.rdl2: She performs Romanian deadlifts with perfect form: soft knees, she pushes her hips back and slides the one barbell down along her thighs to mid-shin with a flat back, then squeezes her glutes and stands tall again holding the same barbell. The barbell never leaves her hands. Slow controlled reps. Static camera from the side.
videos.pullup: She performs strict pull-ups with perfect form: from a dead hang she pulls her chest toward the bar until her chin is over it, elbows driving down, no swinging or kipping, then lowers herself slowly back to a full hang. Her hands stay on the bar the whole time. Static camera from the front.
videos.legpress2: She performs seated leg press reps with perfect form: back flat against the pad, she pushes the foot plate away through her heels until her legs are almost straight without locking her knees, then bends her knees slowly back to 90 degrees. Her feet stay on the foot plate the whole time. Static camera from the side.
videos.kettlebell2: She performs two-handed kettlebell swings with perfect form: both hands on the handle the whole time, she hikes the kettlebell back between her legs, then drives her hips forward to swing it straight out in front to chest height with straight arms, flat back, standing tall at the top. Powerful rhythmic reps. Static camera from the side.
videos.goblet: She performs goblet squats with perfect form: holding the one dumbbell against her chest with both hands, she sits her hips down between her heels until her thighs are below parallel, knees tracking over toes, chest up, then stands back up. The dumbbell stays at her chest the whole time. Static camera, three-quarter front view.
videos.rudern2: She performs seated cable rows with perfect form: torso upright and still, she pulls the V-handle straight back to her stomach, elbows close to her body, squeezes her shoulder blades, then extends her arms forward slowly. The handle stays on the low cable at stomach height the whole time. Static camera from the side.
videos.curl2: She performs standing dumbbell biceps curls with perfect form: elbows pinned to her sides, she curls both dumbbells up to her shoulders, squeezes, then lowers them all the way down slowly. One dumbbell stays in each hand the whole time. No swinging. Static camera, three-quarter front view.
